content.text:
**Analyzing the Task Rule**

I've zeroed in on the core of the problem: counting blue squares within a 3x3 input. The count will be between one and four. The background color derivation involves removing any "one" colors and then identifying the most frequent color remaining, using a color count function. It's time to refine this into operational steps.
